tools.name: A 3D Model of a Diesel Particulate Filter [Chemical Reaction Engineering Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Chemical Reaction Engineering Module (Reactors with Porous Catalysts): A 3D Model of a Diesel Particulate Filter.
